title: DC-area forecast: Rain chances increase by tonight; clearing by Sunday afternoon
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly cloudy this afternoon, but with some peeks of sun, as highs reach the upper 70s to low 80s. Rain chances increase late.

What’s next? Showers and storms become more likely this evening into the overnight hours. A lingering shower is possible early Sunday before skies partially clear. A nicer start to the workweek, with decreasing humidity before heat and humidity ramp back up by midweek.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Mostly cloudy and muggy today, rain tonight. Meh. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): Mostly cloudy skies, with some peeks of sun, as afternoon highs reach the upper 70s to low 80s. It feels muggy as dew points climb into the upper 60s and low 70s. A spotty shower is possible at any time, but most rain holds off until evening. Light winds from the southeast around 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Showers and storms become more likely at times, especially after 7 p.m. or so. Some overnight storms could produce heavy rain. The bulk of the rain should taper off by dawn. Muggy lows dip into the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): A leftover shower or two could linger into the morning. Partly to mostly cloudy morning skies gradually give way to increasing afternoon sun, with highs in the low to mid-80s. Dew points in the low 70s keep it feeling muggy. Another shower or two could pop up midday or early afternoon as light winds shift to come from the northwest. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear and dry as humidity begins to decrease. Lows fall into the mid- to upper 60s. Confidence: Medium

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Nicer to start the workweek, with highs Monday and Tuesday in the upper 70s to low 80s, and dew points falling from the 60s into the 50s. Skies are generally partly to mostly sunny as high pressure gradually builds in, though a passing shower can't be totally ruled out Monday. Confidence: Medium

Temperatures and humidity creep up Wednesday and Thursday. Highs in the low to mid-80s Wednesday reach the mid- to upper 80s Thursday, while dew points climb back well into the 60s. It should be generally dry other than a shower possible late Thursday. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 12

An intense 1934 cloudburst dumped over 4 inches of rain—most of it in a single hour—turning streets into rivers and overwhelming infrastructure across the city.
